title: Senior Substation Electrical Engineer
description:
At EXP , we’re driven to provide innovative solutions for the world’s built and natural environments. As an employee-owned, multidisciplinary engineering firm, we bring together engineers, architects, designers, scientists, and technical leaders to solve complex challenges across the energy sector. Together, we are EXP .
Are you ready to design your future?
Be our next Senior / Principal High-Voltage & HVDC Substation Electrical Engineer .
Your Work Environment at EXP

In this role, you will be part of EXP ’s Energy Division, supporting projects across electrical power generation, transmission, and substations, including hydroelectric facilities, renewable energy (wind and solar), medium-, high-, and extra-high-voltage transmission systems, and advanced substation infrastructure. This position can be remotely or out of any of our US offices.
You will collaborate with a highly multidisciplinary team and serve as a technical authority on complex high-voltage projects. This role offers long-term growth toward Principal and Technical Authority leadership positions within EXP ’s U.S. Energy practice.
What a day at EXP has in store for you

• Function as a senior technical authority and design lead in MV, HV, and EHV substations up to 765 kV, including HVDC and FACTS systems, supporting transmission, renewable interconnection, and industrial power projects.

• Perform and direct the detailed electrical and physical design of utility substations ranging from 15 kV through 765 kV, including EHV transmission substations, major interconnection facilities, and complex grid-scale infrastructure.

• Provide technical leadership on EHV system considerations, including insulation coordination, grounding and step-and-touch analysis, EMF considerations, equipment clearances, constructability, and safety requirements at the 500 kV-765 kV level.

• Lead and review advanced electrical system studies, including:

• Load flow and contingency analysis

• Short-circuit and grounding analysis

• Protection coordination and arc-flash studies

• Harmonic analysis and harmonic filter coordination

• HVDC and FACTS system performance and interface studies

• Perform and direct others in the execution of detailed substation design deliverables, ensuring technical accuracy, constructability, and compliance with client, utility, and industry standards.

• Develop and oversee high-voltage design deliverables, including:

• One-line diagrams and AC/DC schematics

• Protection and control philosophies and relay schemes

• SCADA, communications, and substation automation architecture

• Station physical layouts, elevations, and equipment arrangements

• Grounding grids, lightning protection systems, EMF considerations, and yard/area lighting design

• Serve as lead engineer or discipline lead on multiple concurrent substation projects, managing technical scope, priorities, and coordination across disciplines and offices.

• Perform technical QA/QC reviews for substation deliverables produced across multiple projects and offices, ensuring consistency with EXP standards and client requirements.

• Act as a trusted technical advisor and primary engineering interface with utilities, ISOs/RTOs, EPC contractors, OEMs, and renewable developers, supporting project execution and strengthening long-term client relationships.

• Provide technical guidance for HVDC and FACTS-related scopes, including front-end engineering design activities, system studies, development of technical specifications, and review of vendor design submissions, as applicable.

• Support factory acceptance testing (FAT), commissioning, and site activities, providing technical support during construction, testing, and energization phases.

• Mentor and support the development of junior and intermediate engineers, promoting technical excellence and knowledge sharing within the Energy Division.

• Collaborate with Project Managers to ensure technical quality, schedule adherence, and budget compliance.

Senior Accountant - Israel

We're hiring a Senior Accountant, based in Israel, to own accounting, financial reporting, and statutory and tax compliance. Reporting to the Accounting Director, this is a hands-on role combining execution and ownership: closing the books under US GAAP, preparing statutory accounts, managing indirect tax and supporting direct tax, owning the vendor and AP cycle, leading the local audit, and partnering with the global finance team on group reporting. We're looking for someone hungry - ambitious, curious, and here to build, not just maintain.

You'll be:

• Own end-to-end accounting and financial reporting in accordance with US GAAP and Fireblocks group accounting policies, and lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close on group deadlines - general ledger integrity, balance sheet reconciliations, cut-off journals, accruals and prepayments, and flux analysis with clear explanations of the drivers.

• Own the end-to-end Accounts Payable cycle: vendor onboarding, invoice processing, approval workflow, payment runs, AP-to-GL reconciliation, and AP aging and accrual completeness at close.

• Oversee daily banking operations performed by the bookkeeping team - reviewing bank and credit card reconciliations and employee expense claims, monitoring the cash position, and supporting treasury on funding and payment execution.

• Own intercompany balances and recharges across group entities, including monthly reconciliation, settlement, and support for consolidation eliminations.

• Prepare Israeli statutory financial statements, including the bridge from US GAAP to the statutory basis, and manage the external audit end-to-end.

• Support Israeli direct tax compliance in partnership with the Group Tax Director and external advisors: annual corporate tax return, tax reconciliation, advance payments (mikdamot), and Israeli Tax Authority inquiries and audits.

• Own Israeli indirect tax and withholding compliance: VAT reporting and reconciliation, monthly and annual withholding reports, withholding certificates, and treaty-based withholding on cross-border payments.

• Review monthly payroll, including statutory contributions, pension and keren hishtalmut, severance provisions, payroll journals, and reconciliation to the GL.

• Own the finance systems landscape - NetSuite, Coupa, and banking platforms - safeguarding data integrity and driving configuration and process improvements as the business scales.

• Identify and implement opportunities to streamline and automate accounting processes using AI tools, and help set the standard for how the team uses them.

Role Summary
PLOS is a nonprofit Open Access publisher with an ambitious mission: to help transform research communication so that science can be shared, understood and used more effectively. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Product team for a 12-month maternity cover contract.It's an interesting time to join us.
Research publishing is changing rapidly. Researchers' expectations are changing. Technology is creating possibilities that didn't exist a few years ago. And at PLOS we're rethinking some of the services, systems and assumptions that have shaped scholarly publishing for decades.
That means there are interesting product problems to solve - not just features to deliver.
You'll take responsibility for a product area and work with designers, engineers and colleagues across PLOS to understand the problems that matter, work out where we can make the greatest difference and help the team learn its way towards good solutions.
Although this is a fixed-term role, it isn't a caretaker role. You'll be joining active product teams working on significant problems and will have plenty of opportunity to shape what we do and how we do it.
How we work
We want our product teams to be curious, evidence-led and comfortable with uncertainty.
We don't expect a Product Manager to arrive with all the answers. We do expect them to ask good questions.
You'll use continuous discovery alongside delivery: spending time with users, looking at data, understanding the wider service, identifying assumptions and finding practical ways to test them.
You'll help the team break large problems into smaller things we can learn from, rather than waiting until everything is known before we release something.
And you'll make the team's thinking visible - explaining what we're trying to achieve, what we've learned, what we're uncertain about and why we're making the choices we are.
Responsibilities
As a Senior Product Manager, you'll:

•
Understand the problem. Build a deep understanding of our users, their needs and behaviours, as well as the organisational, operational and technical context surrounding them.

•
Shape product direction. Work out where the greatest opportunities lie within your area and help translate PLOS's objectives into clear product outcomes and priorities.

•
Practise continuous discovery. Work closely with design, engineering and others to explore problems, identify assumptions and regularly test ideas with users and through data.

•
Turn uncertainty into learning. Frame hypotheses, design useful experiments and look for the smallest sensible way to learn whether we're heading in the right direction.

•
Make good product decisions. Weigh evidence, impact, effort, risk and opportunity when deciding what to pursue - and what not to pursue.

•
Measure whether things are getting better. Define useful measures of success and use qualitative and quantitative evidence to understand whether our work is having the intended effect.

•
Work iteratively. Help the team deliver in small steps, learn from what happens and adapt rather than treating plans as fixed commitments.

•
Communicate your thinking. Clearly explain problems, evidence, choices, trade-offs and learning to people with very different levels of technical and product knowledge.

•
Create strong feedback loops. Use conversations, demos, reviews and other forums to get useful feedback early rather than presenting finished thinking late.

•
Work as part of a team. Create the conditions in which designers, engineers and other specialists can contribute to product decisions rather than treating product management as something the PM does alone.

•
Look beyond the product interface. Understand the wider service, including processes, systems and teams around it, and recognise when solving a user problem requires changing more than software.

Our team is passionate about re‑engineering the way electric utilities solve their toughest challenges. We combine innovation, technical rigor, and a client‑first mindset to deliver exceptional engineering solutions-from detailed design to advanced modeling and analysis.

• Committed to continuous learning and process improvement, consistently seeking opportunities to enhance quality and efficiency

• Develop and present technical reports , support marketing and business development efforts, and build strong relationships with clients and contractors.

What you need to have (minimum qualifications):

• B.S. in Electrical, Civil, Mechanical, or Power Engineering (or related field)

• 5+ years of transmission line engineering experience (design, analysis, modeling, or similar)

• 5+ years of experience working with an electric utility, EPC, or engineering consulting firm

• 5+ years of experience working in PLS‑CADD

What we would like you to have (preferred qualifications):

• Knowledge of the practical application of industry standards such as: NESC , IEEE , ANSI , FERC‑881 , and FAC‑008 standards

• Ability to plan and manage assignments and clearly communicate barriers to complete tasks on budget/schedule

title: Temporary Designer, Delish
description:
Be Part of What's Next
Bring bold visual storytelling to one of the internet's most-loved food brands. As Temporary Designer at Delish, you'll help shape engaging experiences across digital, social, video, and print, creating work that inspires millions of food lovers every day.
About Hearst Magazines (Why Us?)
Hearst Magazines is one of the largest publishers in the world, with 30 brands , including Cosmopolitan, ELLE, Esquire, Good Housekeeping, Harper’s BAZAAR, Popular Mechanics, and Delish. We reach more than 150 million people every month in the United States alone. But we’re more than just our magazines. We engage our audience across all mediums and channels-print, digital, video, and social-with sophisticated content creation, distribution, and data capabilities. We create, package, and sell products with cutting-edge technology and proprietary platforms. Together, we are reinventing publishing for the 21st century.
Key Responsibilities (What You Are Doing)

• Design compelling creative assets for digital, social, video, and print platforms that elevate the Delish brand.

• Collaborate with social and video teams to develop templates, graphic systems, title cards, lower thirds, end cards, thumbnails, and other visual assets for recurring content series.

• Translate digital templates into Figma to support efficient editorial workflows.

• Build and manage content within the content management system while maintaining brand consistency and quality.

• Create engaging recipe graphics, infographics, and social media assets for platforms including Instagram and Facebook.

• Design magazine layouts, manage production files throughout the creative process, and ensure projects remain on schedule.

• Set up Figma files for new quarterly issues and export/package final files for production.

• Produce occasional editorial illustrations and support cross-functional creative initiatives as needed.

Qualifications (What We’re Looking For)

• Bachelor's degree in graphic arts or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 4-5 years of experience in graphic design, preferably within publishing, editorial media, or a related creative environment.

• Experience designing for editorial, digital, and social platforms while maintaining a cohesive visual brand identity.

• Proficiency with Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, and a basic understanding of HTML.

• Strong typography, photo-editing, and visual storytelling skills with a portfolio demonstrating excellence across digital and social media.

• Ability to distinguish platform-specific design needs rather than simply resizing assets across channels.

• Collaborative mindset with the ability to incorporate feedback, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• Self-motivated, solution-oriented, and comfortable working independently while partnering across creative and editorial teams.

• Motion design, animation, video editing, or Adobe After Effects experience is a plus.

• This is a remote position, with occasional days in the office as needed.
